translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
chunkay quraish kay log aadi hain ,
yani woh sardi aur garmi kay moasmon mein ( yamen aur shaam kay ) safar kernay kay aadi hain ,
iss liye unhen chahiye kay woh uss ghar kay malik ki ibadat keren
jiss ney bhook ki halat mein unhen khaney ko diya , aur bad-amni say unhen mehfooz rakha .
